myelectionday.sos.state.ms.us.en: My Election Day (Mississippi Secretary of State)
myelectionday.sos.state.ms.us.es: el buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado de Mississippi

reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Monday, October 5, 2026. Mississippi has no same-day or Election Day registration.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 5 de octubre de 2026. Mississippi no tiene registro el mismo día ni el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: Voter Registration Deadline (General): Applicants who register in-person in the Circuit Clerk’s office or Municipal Clerk’s office today, and those who mail registration applications post-marked no later than today are eligible to vote in the General Election.

mail_request.notes: No deadline to request a mail absentee ballot found on the SOS absentee page or the 2026 Elections Calendar.

mail_return.en: Mail your ballot to your circuit clerk postmarked on or before Election Day, Tuesday, November 3. The clerk must receive it by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, for it to count.
mail_return.es: Manda tu boleta a la oficina del secretario del tribunal de circuito (Circuit Clerk) con matasellos del Día de las Elecciones, el martes 3 de noviembre, o antes. La oficina debe recibirla a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del martes 10 de noviembre de 2026 para que cuente.
mail_return.quote: Absentee Ballots Returned by Mail Receipt Deadline, 5:00 p.m.: Circuit Clerks' Offices must be in actual receipt of absentee ballots returned by mail for ballots to be timely. Ballots returned by mail must be postmarked on or before Election Day.

early_hours.en: If you qualify to vote absentee in person, go to your circuit clerk's office from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays, or 8 a.m. to noon on Saturday, October 24, or Saturday, October 31. October 31 is the last day.
early_hours.es: Si cumples los requisitos para votar en ausencia en persona, ve a la oficina del secretario del tribunal de circuito (Circuit Clerk) de 8 a. m. a 5 p. m. entre semana, o de 8 a. m. a mediodía el sábado 24 de octubre o el sábado 31 de octubre. El 31 de octubre es el último día.
early_hours.quote: In addition, the circuit Clerk’s Office will be open for in -person absentee voting from 8:00 a.m. to noon on October 24, 2026, and October 31, 2026. The deadline to vote in-person absentee will be October 31, 2026.
early_hours.en_after: In-person absentee voting ended October 31. Vote at your polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación en ausencia en persona terminó el 31 de octubre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.

cure.notes: No absentee ballot cure process found on sos.ms.gov.

in_person.en: Mississippi has no early voting for everyone. If you qualify for absentee voting, for example you're 65 or older, will be away from home on Election Day, or have to work while the polls are open, you can vote absentee in person at your county's circuit clerk's office. Bring your photo ID and be ready to give your reason.
in_person.es: Mississippi no tiene votación anticipada para todos. Si cumples los requisitos para votar en ausencia, por ejemplo tienes 65 años o más, vas a estar fuera de casa el Día de las Elecciones o tienes que trabajar mientras están abiertas las urnas, puedes votar en ausencia en persona en la oficina del secretario del tribunal de circuito (Circuit Clerk) de tu condado. Lleva tu identificación con foto y prepárate para dar tu razón.
in_person.quote: Your Circuit Clerk (or Deputy Circuit Clerk) will confirm you are a registered voter in the municipality by checking the Statewide Elections Management System, confirm your address, and check your photo ID. You will also be asked your reason for absentee voting.

first_time.en: First time voting after registering by mail? If your registration wasn't verified, you'll have to show ID the first time you go to the polls.
first_time.es: ¿Es tu primera vez votando después de registrarte por correo? Si tu registro no fue verificado, tendrás que mostrar una identificación la primera vez que vayas a votar.
first_time.quote: Keep in mind that first time, mail-in, unverified registrants must show ID the first time they go to the polls.

locator_label.en: My Election Day (Mississippi Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Buscador oficial de lugares de votación (Secretaría de Estado de Mississippi)

rule.en: Enter your home address in My Election Day to find your polling place and sample ballot. Polling places are updated by local officials, so it's a good idea to confirm yours with your county circuit clerk.
rule.es: Escribe la dirección de tu casa en el buscador oficial del estado (My Election Day) para encontrar tu lugar de votación y tu boleta de muestra. Los lugares de votación los actualizan las autoridades locales, así que conviene confirmar el tuyo con el secretario del tribunal de circuito de tu condado (Circuit Clerk).
rule.quote: NOTICE: Polling location information is provided and updated by local election officials . It is recommended you confirm your polling place with your county circuit clerk.

en: Mississippi driver's license, including the Mississippi Mobile ID
ID card from any Mississippi state agency
Employee photo ID from the U.S. government, the State of Mississippi, or a Mississippi county, city or other local government entity
Mississippi license to carry a pistol or revolver, with your photo
Student photo ID from an accredited Mississippi college, university, or community or junior college
Any other photo ID from the U.S. government or another state government
es: Licencia de conducir de Mississippi, incluida la Mississippi Mobile ID
Identificación de cualquier dependencia del estado de Mississippi
Identificación de empleado con foto del gobierno de EE. UU., del estado de Mississippi o de un condado, ciudad u otra entidad de gobierno local de Mississippi
Licencia de Mississippi para portar pistola o revólver, con tu foto
Identificación militar de EE. UU. con foto
Identificación de estudiante con foto de una universidad o colegio comunitario acreditado de Mississippi
Mississippi Voter Identification Card (credencial de votante de Mississippi)
Cualquier otra identificación con foto del gobierno de EE. UU. o de otro gobierno estatal
accepted.quote: Any one of the following types of photo IDs may be used on Election Day:

expired.en: Most IDs on the list count as valid if they have no expiration date or were issued in the last 10 years. The carry license, the student ID and other government photo IDs must not be expired.
expired.es: La mayoría de las identificaciones de la lista son válidas si no tienen fecha de vencimiento o se expidieron en los últimos 10 años. La licencia para portar armas, la identificación de estudiante y otras identificaciones con foto del gobierno no pueden estar vencidas.
expired.quote: Valid means an official government document that establishes the voter’s identity and has no expiration date or has an issuance date not more than ten (10) years prior to the date the document is presented.

without.en: No photo ID on Election Day? You'll vote an affidavit ballot. To make it count, show an acceptable photo ID at your circuit clerk's office by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. No ID at all? The circuit clerk's office issues a free Mississippi Voter ID Card.
without.es: ¿No llevas identificación con foto el Día de las Elecciones? Votarás con una boleta de declaración jurada (affidavit ballot). Para que cuente, muestra una identificación con foto aceptada en la oficina del secretario del tribunal de circuito (Circuit Clerk) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del martes 10 de noviembre de 2026. ¿No tienes ninguna? Esa oficina da gratis la Mississippi Voter ID Card.
without.quote: Voter ID Affidavit Ballot Deadline, 5:00 p.m.: Last day affidavit voters who cast an affidavit ballot by reason of voter ID may present an acceptable form of photo ID or complete an affidavit of religious objection in the Circuit Clerk's Office.

who.en: You can vote absentee by mail in Mississippi if you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia por correo en Mississippi si:
who.quote: Any person who is sixty-five (65) years of age or older.

en: are temporarily living outside your county of residence (the ballot must be mailed to an address outside your city or town)
have a temporary or permanent physical disability that makes voting in person a substantial hardship or could put you or others in danger
are the parent, spouse or dependent of a person with a disability who is hospitalized outside your county or more than 50 miles from home, and will be with them on Election Day
are incarcerated but have not been convicted of a disenfranchising crime
es: vives temporalmente fuera de tu condado de residencia (la boleta se debe mandar a una dirección fuera de tu ciudad o pueblo)
tienes una discapacidad física temporal o permanente que hace que votar en persona sea muy difícil o que pueda ponerte en peligro a ti o a otros
eres padre o madre, cónyuge o dependiente de una persona con discapacidad que está hospitalizada fuera de tu condado o a más de 50 millas de tu casa, y vas a estar con ella el Día de las Elecciones
estás encarcelado pero no te han condenado por un delito que te quite el derecho a votar
who_list.quote: Any person who is temporarily residing outside of their county of residence, and the ballot must be mailed to an address outside the municipality.

witness.en: Mark your ballot in front of a notary or another official who can give oaths, then sign the affidavit on the back of the envelope and have them sign too. If you have a temporary or permanent physical disability, any witness 18 or older can sign instead. The application needs the same kind of witness.
witness.es: Marca tu boleta frente a un notario u otro funcionario autorizado para tomar juramentos, luego firma la declaración al reverso del sobre y pídele que firme también. Si tienes una discapacidad física temporal o permanente, puede firmar cualquier testigo de 18 años o más. La solicitud necesita el mismo tipo de testigo.
witness.quote: All absentee ballot envelopes must be witnessed/signed by an official authorized to administer oath, such as a notary public, unless the voter is temporary or permanently physically disabled.

dropbox.notes: The SOS absentee page says to mail the ballot to the circuit clerk; no drop box information found.

gear.en: Leave the campaign shirts and buttons at home. It's against the law to post or hand out campaign literature within 150 feet of the polling place, unless it's on private property, and that includes T-shirts, buttons and the like with a candidate's name or likeness. Loitering within 30 feet is out too.
gear.es: Deja en casa las camisetas y botones de campaña. Está prohibido por ley poner o repartir propaganda de campaña a menos de 150 pies del lugar de votación, a menos que sea en propiedad privada, y eso incluye camisetas, botones y cosas parecidas con el nombre o la imagen de un candidato. Tampoco se permite quedarse merodeando a menos de 30 pies.
gear.quote: It is unlawful to post or distribute any campaign literature within 150 feet of the polling place unless on private property. This includes wearing any T-shirts, buttons, etc. with a candidate’s name or likeness as well.

phone.notes: No statute or SOS guidance on phones or ballot photos found (same finding as docs/faq-sources.json).

line.en: If you're in line at 7 p.m., you have the right to vote.
line.es: Si estás en la fila a las 7 p. m., tienes derecho a votar.
line.quote: All voters have the right to mark a ballot in private, free from intimidation or force, and to cast a ballot if in line to vote at 7 p.m.

tradition.en: For 2026, the Secretary of State ran a contest for Mississippi voters to design the I voted sticker for all 82 counties.
tradition.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado organizó un concurso para que los votantes de Mississippi diseñaran el sticker de "I voted" para los 82 condados.
tradition.quote: Anyone 18 years and older who is registered to vote in Mississippi is encouraged to design and submit artwork to be used as the "I Voted" sticker for all 82 counties during the 2026 election cycle .

provisional.notes: Only the voter ID affidavit ballot rule was found (in id.without); no general affidavit ballot page read.

line.en: You can still vote. If you're in line at 7 p.m., you have the right to cast your ballot.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Si estás en la fila a las 7 p. m., tienes derecho a votar.
line.quote: All voters have the right to mark a ballot in private, free from intimidation or force, and to cast a ballot if in line to vote at 7 p.m.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.ms.gov (curl worked): Absentee Voting Information, Election FAQs, Elections 101, Voter ID pages, the 2026 Elections Calendar PDF (last revised 9/8/2026), My Election Day, and the October 21, 2025 sticker contest release. EARLY VOTING vs states.js: states.js has kind 'none'. Mississippi does have in-person absentee voting for voters who meet an excuse, ending at noon on Saturday, October 31, 2026. START DATE CONFLICT: the SOS absentee FAQ says 'You may vote absentee in person from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, beginning September 19, 2026, at the circuit Clerk’s office, through October 31, 2026.' The SOS 2026 Elections Calendar says '21st Absentee Ballots Available: Earliest day to vote by an absentee ballot in the Circuit Clerk’s Office in the General Election.' (September 21; September 19 is a Saturday). The file leaves out the start date. End time: the calendar says '31st In-Person Absentee Voting Deadline, 12:00 p.m. (General): Circuit Clerk’s Offices MUST remain open from 8 a.m. until noon'; the FAQ agrees on noon for October 24 and 31. Mail return: the FAQ ('received on or within five (5) business days of the election, or November 10, 2026') and the calendar (5 p.m. November 10) agree. In-person absentee eligibility is a longer list than mail (it adds working during poll hours and being away from home on Election Day); how.in_person names three examples. Sticker: the contest release is from 2025; no winner announcement was found on sos.ms.gov. Mail request deadline, drop boxes, ballot tracker, cure, phone rule and general provisional rules not found; left missing.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Polls will open at 7:00 a.m. and close at 7:00 p.m.
